name: Adult Psychiatry
description: Comprehensive inpatient and outpatient psychiatric evaluation, diagnosis, and pharmacological management for adults presenting with the full spectrum of mental health disorders.

name: Child & Adolescent Psychiatry
description: Specialized psychiatric care for children and teenagers, addressing neurodevelopmental, mood, anxiety, and behavioral disorders using family-centered, developmentally appropriate treatment approaches.

name: Addiction Medicine
description: Multidisciplinary evaluation and treatment of substance use disorders including alcohol, opioids, stimulants, and polysubstance dependencies, incorporating medically assisted treatment (MAT) and psychosocial rehabilitation.

name: Perinatal & Women's Mental Health
description: Specialized psychiatric care addressing mood, anxiety, and psychotic disorders during pregnancy and the postpartum period, with a focus on balancing pharmacological safety with maternal and fetal wellbeing.

name: Forensic Psychiatry
description: Clinical and consultative services at the intersection of psychiatry and law, including competency evaluations, criminal responsibility assessments, and management of mentally disordered offenders.

name: Geriatric Psychiatry
description: Psychiatric care for adults aged 65 and above, specializing in late-life depression, dementia-related behavioral symptoms, and neuropsychiatric sequelae of neurodegenerative and chronic medical conditions.

name: Schizophrenia & Psychosis Center
description: Dedicated center for the treatment of schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, delusional disorder, and first-episode psychosis using Coordinated Specialty Care (CSC) and evidence-based antipsychotic pharmacotherapy.

name: Sleep Medicine & Neuropsychiatry
description: Diagnosis and integrated treatment of sleep disorders (insomnia, OSA, narcolepsy) and neuropsychiatric conditions, leveraging polysomnography, CBT-I, and psychopharmacological management.

name: Mood Disorders & Bipolar Center
description: Expert clinical management of unipolar and bipolar mood disorders through mood-stabilizing pharmacotherapy, psychoeducation, neuromodulation review, and long-term relapse prevention programming.

name: Eating Disorders & Body Image Program
description: Multidisciplinary treatment program for anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, binge eating disorder, and ARFID, providing medical stabilization, nutritional rehabilitation, and evidence-based psychotherapy.

name: Trauma & PTSD Center
description: Specialized center delivering first-line trauma treatments including Prolonged Exposure (PE), EMDR, and Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT) for PTSD, complex trauma, and adverse childhood experience sequelae.

name: Substance Use & Recovery Program
description: Recovery-oriented counseling and group therapy program for individuals with substance use disorders, utilizing DBT-based relapse prevention, Motivational Interviewing, and community support models.

name: Adolescent Therapy Center
description: Individual and family therapy services for children, adolescents, and young adults addressing anxiety, depression, school-related difficulties, and the psychosocial impact of cultural and identity transitions.

name: OCD & Anxiety Disorders Clinic
description: Intensive outpatient clinic specializing in Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) for OCD and its spectrum, alongside evidence-based cognitive and acceptance-based treatments for all anxiety disorder presentations.

name: Family & Couples Therapy
description: Therapeutic services for couples and family units using Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT), the Gottman Method, and systemic family therapy approaches to resolve conflict and strengthen relational bonds.

name: LGBTQ+ Affirming Care Program
description: Affirming, culturally competent mental health services for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, and intersex individuals, addressing minority stress, gender dysphoria, and LGBTQ+-specific identity and family issues.

name: Neuropsychology & Cognitive Rehabilitation
description: Comprehensive neuropsychological assessment and cognitive rehabilitation services following TBI, stroke, and neurodegenerative disease, providing detailed cognitive profiles to guide rehabilitation planning.

name: Grief & Bereavement Center
description: Individual therapy and peer-led support groups for individuals navigating acute grief, complicated grief disorder, and end-of-life care challenges, using evidence-based bereavement models.

name: Crisis Intervention & Acute Care
description: 24/7 acute psychiatric crisis stabilization, suicide risk assessment, and emergency safety planning services across inpatient, emergency department, and community crisis response settings.

name: Community Mental Health
description: Recovery-oriented outreach and psychosocial rehabilitation services for individuals with severe and persistent mental illness, supporting community integration, independent living, and social inclusion.
